text:
katie: Starting staged rollout for v2.3.1 now. Plan: canary 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 30m, 10m checks at each step. Will watch p95, 5xx, and error budget. Please call STOP/GO in this thread if you see issues. Change window: 18:00-18:30 UTC.

deploy-bot: Deployment initiated: v2.3.1 -> prod. Canary group A: 1% traffic. Tracking metrics: p95 latency, 5xx rate, kv-cache hit ratio. CI: green.

katie: tagging @ryan @lucy @devon for oncall/infra visibility. Recommend extra attention to eu-west latency (historic flakiness).

ryan: Seeing small p95 bump in eu-west: baseline 210ms -> 320ms at t+3m, 5xx still at baseline 0.2%. Sending trace sample.

deploy-bot: Canary 1% completed (t+6m). Promoting to 5% as scheduled.

devon: Promoting to 5% now. I will let it run for 10m then re-evaluate.

lucy: Alert: increased 502 spikes from the inference layer in eu-west since t+7m. 502 count: 12 -> 48 in last 4m. Kernel logs show repeated KV cache eviction on these hosts.

lucy: ```
# sample from host r-02-eu
ERR 2026-02-12T18:07:14Z inference.py:cache_miss key=conv-uid-xyz status=miss
ERR 2026-02-12T18:07:15Z worker.cpp:dispatch Failed to load KV shard
```

katie: OK hold. Pausing promotion. @deploy-bot do NOT increase beyond 5%. @ryan @lucy do we want to pin eu-west back to v2.2.8 and rollback traffic for that region while we investigate cache behavior?

ryan: I support pin+rollback for eu-west only. Global canary stays at 5% paused. This looks like a regression in kv-cache heuristics in v2.3.1.

devon: Agreed. I'll run region pin and partial rollback for eu-west. Command I will run: `redwood traffic pin --region eu-west --to v2.2.8 --scope hosts`

deploy-bot: Received command: redwood traffic pin --region eu-west --to v2.2.8 --scope hosts. Starting rollback for 12 hosts in eu-west. ETA ~8m. Notifying load-balancer for gradual shift.

devon: Rollback logs: 10/12 hosts rolled back, 2 still draining. 502s dropping on rolled hosts.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed for 12/12 hosts in eu-west. Region healthy. p95 back to 215ms, 5xx to 0.25%. Global canary remains paused at 5%.

katie: Decision: PAUSE the staged rollout. No further promotions until root cause triaged. Action items: 1) Incident ticket, 2) collect KV cache config diffs between v2.2.8 and v2.3.1, 3) reproduce locally with synthetic traffic, 4) schedule a rollback-postmortem.

lucy: Created INC-2026-221 and attached logs/traces + host list. Linking this slack thread.

ryan: Quick note: we should also check quantization changes that landed in v2.3.1 optimizer path — I suspect memory layout change triggered extra evictions.

katie: Good catch. @devon please prioritize a minimal test that isolates kv-cache churn. ETA for root cause triage update: 2h. If anyone sees regression outside eu-west ping here immediately.

devon: Will run replay now and share results in INC-2026-221.

katie: Thanks all. Thread status: HOLD. We'll re-run a gated canary once we have a fix and a smoke-pass. Marking this thread resolved for the rollout decision; follow-up in the incident ticket. :white_check_mark:
